# Third-party layer: GROK mirror site (UNVERIFIED)

**Everything in this folder is third-party data with no raw evidence behind it. It is not part of the verified corpus in `clean/`, and `clean/` never reads from here.** Every record carries `layer = "third_party_unverified"` and a `provenance` string with the sha256 of the source file.

## Source
- `raw/grok/commandlinefu-mirror-site.tar.xz` (7,897,452 bytes, sha256 `1a20b214014688fbe5550984721c64747370957f0ce8803ca593f2950c22a548`) is a static Apache site generated by a third party with Grok on 2026-11-13. The user supplied it on 2026-11-17.
- The site was built from a `commands.sqlite` that was **not** supplied, and it includes no raw captures.
- `raw/grok/grok_commands.jsonl` holds the read-only extract of its 14,953 command pages, made with `tools/grok/parse_grok.py` (0 parse failures).
- Two kinds of page content were deliberately **not** extracted:
  - AI-written descriptions;
  - "derived" tags guessed from the command text. Tags are never inferred in this archive.

## Files
| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `commands_gap.jsonl` | 582 commands that are absent from `clean/` and pass the same spam rules as the verified pipeline. 581 of them are in `manifests/wayback_only_ids.tsv`. 63 have `title = null`, because the third-party title was a "Comments (N)" heading; `url_slug` keeps the original URL slug instead. Code is `unverified` unless it was compared with one of our own captures. |
| `descriptions_original.jsonl` | 113 original descriptions for commands in `clean/` that have none. Each is used only where the command code is identical to `clean/`. |
| `command_tags.csv` | 17,921 tag pairs on 6,287 commands (6,237 of them in `clean/`), with these statuses: `confirmed_by_our_evidence` (1,077) and `unverified_third_party` (16,844). |
| `excluded.jsonl` | Everything rejected, with a reason: 93 spam and 6 review commands; 1 description whose code differs; 975 truncated tag slugs (`p`, `co`, `date-ma`…); 81 slugs not in our taxonomy; 26 pairs that contradict a complete tag block we captured ourselves. |
| `grok_layer.sqlite` | The three usable tables (`gap_commands`, `description_supplement`, `command_tags`) plus `layer_info`. This is a separate database from `clean/commandlinefu.sqlite`. |
| `layer_stats.json` | Exact counts from the last build. |
| `REVIEW_FINDINGS.md` | The original review of the site, with accuracy checks and defects found. |

## How reliable it is (measured against our own raw evidence)
- **Tags:**
  - 1,136 of our 1,284 verified pairs are also on the site (88%).
  - For the 299 commands where we captured the full tag block, the tag set matches exactly for 253 (85%), and the site has no tags at all for 29.
- **Code:** 17 of 17 matched our Wayback captures in the review. That check is now inside `clean/`: ID 98 came in from our own capture, so `commands_gap.jsonl` has 0 records with a code check.
- **Titles:** the site has 88 wrong "Comments (N)" titles. In this layer they are set to null.

## Rules for use
- Show this data only with a visible "third-party, unverified" label. Never copy it into `clean/` without new raw evidence (a Wayback capture of the page).
- `tag_status` in `clean/` is not changed by this layer; `unknown` still means "not recovered by us".
- Rebuild the layer after every `tools/process.py` run, using `python3 tools/grok/build_grok_layer.py`.
- Do not run archived commands without reading them first.
